physics-killer-05.material: Benda massa $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ obah arah $+x$ kanthi $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake gedhene impuls sing ditampa benda sajrone $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ gaya iki makarya, lan kacepetan benda sakwise gaya ilang? (Ora ana gaya liyane.)
